title: Dream Pop
tagline: Songs that let atmosphere become part of the melody.
summary: Dream pop puts tone, space, and vocal texture at the heart of a song. Guitars and keyboards often blur into soft layers, while melodies stay clear without demanding a forceful delivery. The style took shape in independent scenes and travels across pop, shoegaze, and electronic production. Its artists create intimacy through sound design as much as through lyrics.
origin_place: United Kingdom and the United States

pillars.name: Cocteau Twins
pillars.why: Cocteau Twins made voice and guitar timbre central to a distinctive, impressionistic pop language.

pillars.name: Mazzy Star
pillars.why: Mazzy Star brought a hushed, blues-tinged intimacy to dream pop's spacious arrangements.

pillars.name: Beach House
pillars.why: Beach House carried the style into a later era with carefully repeated melodies and warm keyboard-led textures.
